_note: Interference policy for the shipped GTSIO-520-H R10 study file (web/gtsio520-r10-static-opt1.glb.gz, audited in its plain form from scripts/decode_model.mjs) when its core cycle and exploded layouts are posed by the viewer's procedural sampler (scripts/audit_procedural_poses.py). Touching is always allowed; overlap is not. known_defects is a ratchet: it records what the CURRENTLY PUBLISHED draft still contains in the sampled cycle, may only shrink, and an entry that is no longer observed fails the audit until it is removed. The assembled-pose audit has no ledger (cad-studies/gtsio520-h-static/interference-policy.json). Recording an overlap here is not an acceptance of it.
